topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: I’ve been told I’m moving to a new department, and my mind is racing with thoughts. I’ve spent so much time getting to know the ins and outs of this team, and now I have to start all over again. The familiarity of my routine, the comfort of my colleagues—I’m going to miss these. There’s so much to learn, and I wonder if I’ll fit in. Will they welcome me, or will I be seen as an outsider? Preparing for this transition, I find myself double-checking every detail, making sure I’ve got everything covered, hoping I’ll be able to keep up. I’m eager to prove myself, but the unknown looms large.
